projectInfo.name: PaperTrade
projectInfo.description: NSE Indian-equity short-term price-direction prediction engine + paper-trading book. Predicts 1D/3D/INTRADAY direction using backtested technical strategies, a standalone supervised ML quantile model, macro gates, news sentiment, and an LLM bull/bear/fundamentals debate. Served via a Flask web app and an MCP server.
projectInfo.platform: Python backend (Flask web app + MCP server) with an offline-trained scikit-learn ML model

deployment.primary: Hugging Face Spaces (persistent /data disk, container). Think HF Spaces first for storage/paths/env.
notes: Use os.path.dirname(__file__) or HF paths for data files; NOT pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.
Pickle/file caches do NOT survive HF container restarts — use SQLite (paper_trading.db) instead.
Static JS/CSS is inline in templates (HF CSP blocks external CDNs).
Secrets: .env locally; HF Spaces Secrets tab in prod; sync via export_env_secrets.py.

architecturalKnowledge.pattern: Layered prediction pipeline + service modules (not MVC/MVVM)
layers: Entry points: app.py (Flask UI + paper-trading book + validation), stock_predictor_mcp.py (MCP tools)
Prediction core: predictor_core.py (public API predict_stock_v2 / rank_stocks_v2)
Signal/feature layer: trial_run.py (S1..S20 strategy signals), ml_combiner.py (ML feature funcs)
Context providers: macro_context.py, fred_data.py, news_sentiment.py, fundamentals.py, sector_pulse.py, fii_flow.py, social_sentiment.py, intraday_live.py, price_targets.py
LLM layer: ai_forecast.py (bull/bear/fundamentals debate) -> llm_client.py (provider chain) / ollama_client.py
Data layer: data_sources.py (multi-source OHLCV + live price), universe.py (dynamic NSE universe), database.py (SQLite: trades, orders, snapshots, postmortems)
Standalone ML: ml_predictor/ (features -> dataset -> train -> infer, 21 committed joblib estimators)
Research/backtests: research/ (offline analysis, never imported by prod prediction path)
dataFlowPredictionPipeline: 1. Market gates (VIX>25 hard block; VIX 20-25 size cut; Nifty<EMA200 -40% expected; macro/FRED risk-off cuts)
2. Strategy signals (20+ NSE-backtested booleans, fire if triggered in last 5 bars)
3. ML feature score (11 weighted features -> 0-100 + logistic prob)
5. Sector pulse (NSE sector heatmap -> leading/lagging flag)
7. AI forecast (up to 4-call LLM debate -> synthesis JSON) with heuristic fallback
9. Risk (ATR14 stop, R:R targets scaled to timeframe)

technologyStack.web: Flask (server-rendered templates/index.html, inline JS/CSS in static/)
technologyStack.ml: scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting quantile regressors + isotonic-calibrated direction classifier; joblib persistence. No lightgbm/xgboost/torch (HF-safe).
technologyStack.dataSources: yfinance + NSE archives + Twelve Data + Alpha Vantage (fallback chain in data_sources.py)
technologyStack.llmProviderChain: OpenRouter free -> Groq -> Cerebras -> HuggingFace Router -> Gemini -> SambaNova -> NVIDIA NIM -> Ollama (local last-resort). GitHub Models removed.
technologyStack.database: SQLite (paper_trading.db) — trades, pending orders, prediction snapshots, postmortems, ohlcv_cache blob
caches: ohlcv_cache table in paper_trading.db (SQLite blob, NOT file-based)

predictor_core.py.role: Main prediction API (used by MCP + Flask). MUST stay stable.

trial_run.py.role: All strategy signal generators S1..S20, S_CTRIO, S_CAPFLOW, S_SEASONAL etc. NSE-verified stats in predictor_core._STRATEGY_STATS_DEFAULT — do not change without re-running backtest.

ml_combiner.py.role: ML feature functions used by predictor_core.get_ml_feature_score

ai_forecast.py.role: LLM bull/bear/fundamentals debate -> synthesis. Trigger guardrails + ATR clamp (prod-only). Output: should_buy, entry_price, direction, ranges.

llm_client.py.role: Provider chain + Ollama fallback + rate-limit handling

data_sources.py.role: Multi-source OHLCV + live price with fallback chains. Do NOT change signatures.

universe.py.role: Dynamic full-NSE universe (~2062 EQ stocks). Replaces old nse_universe.py.

database.py.role: SQLite paper-trading book + prediction validation audit trail

macro_context.py.role: Macro gates (S&P500, USD/INR, crude) + FRED regime gate

fundamentals.py.role: Stock fundamentals scorer (PE/D-E/rev/FCF/ROE). MUST stay stable.

sector_pulse.py.role: NSE 10-sector heatmap + rotation. MUST stay stable.

risk_engine.py.role: Portfolio risk metrics (Sharpe, drawdown, beta, Kelly)

top5_picker.py.role: Top picks (up to 20) INTRADAY/1D/3D, concurrent, ATR-ranked, progressive streaming

app.py.role: Flask UI + paper-trading book + validation + all /api routes

stock_predictor_mcp.py.role: MCP server entry point. Imports predictor_core.

ml_predictor/features.py.role: Shared point-in-time feature builder (37 lookahead-safe features)

ml_predictor/infer.py.role: MLPredictor — quantile forecast per TF. Batch via _raw_predict (fast); per-row _predict_tf is ~1000x slower.

ml_predictor/dataset.py.role: Build training_data.csv from ohlcv cache (offline). Labels up/dn = max/min excursion; dir = excess-of-Nifty.

criticalConstraintsDoNotBreak: predict_stock_v2 / rank_stocks_v2 / timeframe_to_dates signatures (used by MCP + Flask).
trial_run.py strategy stats in predictor_core._STRATEGY_STATS_DEFAULT are NSE-verified — do not change without re-running the backtest.
Do not add lightgbm/xgboost/torch (HF Spaces image safety).
Do not put data files behind pathlib.Path(__file__).parent; do not rely on file/pickle caches surviving HF restarts.

codeGenerationGuidelines.paths: os.path.dirname(__file__) or HF /data paths; never pathlib(__file__).parent for data.
codeGenerationGuidelines.persistence: SQLite (paper_trading.db) for anything that must survive HF restarts — not pickle/file caches.
codeGenerationGuidelines.frontend: Inline JS/CSS only (HF CSP blocks external URLs). Bump cache-buster ?v=YYYYMMDD<letter> in templates/index.html on JS/CSS change.
codeGenerationGuidelines.stability: Keep listed public signatures stable; prod prediction path must not import research/.
codeGenerationGuidelines.ml: Batch model inference with MLPredictor._raw_predict over a full matrix; never loop _predict_tf per row in bulk jobs.
codeGenerationGuidelines.testing: Add/extend tests/test_api_contract.py for new endpoints (schema + field types).
codeGenerationGuidelines.backtestMetrics: Distinguish MidHit (band-midpoint, ~90%, soft) from DirAcc/DirHit (directional, ~40-50%, the real metric). Use training_data_extra.csv (has 12 extra features); training_data.csv lacks them.

researchScripts.note: Offline analysis only; never imported by the production prediction path.
key: research/ml_backtest.py (ML accuracy + target-exit P&L; authoritative DirAcc/MidHit table)
